# Decision tables
The kit's DMN 1.3 tables (`../kit/contracts/dmn/*.dmn`), rendered. Hit policy UNIQUE: exactly one rule matches any input. `-` means any value. Every rule names the requirement or contract line it encodes; `harness/dmn_check.py` proves the tables complete, non-overlapping and typed, and `features/decisions.feature` exercises every reachable rule.

## actions_gate (`actions_gate.dmn`)
today = the run clock's UTC date (JDL-088); the stamp is the splits file's, written by the real wall clock (JDL-043).

Inputs: `actions_eligible` (boolean); `force_actions` (boolean); `splits_stamp` (string: "none", "before_today", "today")  
Outputs: `action` ∈ "refresh", "skip_fresh", "none"; `detail_part`

| rule | actions_eligible | force_actions | splits_stamp | → | action | detail_part | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| r1 | `false` | `-` | `-` | | none |  | JDL-086: not eligible, no actions part in the detail |
| r2 | `true` | `true` | `-` | | refresh | {s} split(s), {d} dividend(s);  | JDL-091 force |
| r3 | `true` | `false` | `"none"` | | refresh | {s} split(s), {d} dividend(s);  | JDL-091 no stamp |
| r4 | `true` | `false` | `"before_today"` | | refresh | {s} split(s), {d} dividend(s);  | JDL-091 stale stamp |
| r5 | `true` | `false` | `"today"` | | skip_fresh | actions fresh;  | JDL-091 |

| r1 | `"eodhd"` | `"stock"` | | raw | true | true | adjustment.md s1 row 1; JDL-086 |
| r2 | `"eodhd"` | `"etf"` | | raw | true | true | adjustment.md s1 row 2 (bond_etf -> etf); JDL-086 |
| r3 | `"eodhd"` | `"crypto"` | | split_adjusted | false | false | adjustment.md s1 row 3; JDL-086 (declared class, not suffix) |

| r5 | `"yahoo-csv"` | `-` | | split_adjusted | false | false | adjustment.md s1 row 5; JDL-070 |

## command_by_store_state (`command_store_state.dmn`)
What each store-touching command does when the addressed series is absent or filled. Revision 2026-10-23 (wave 2): the two differential rows carry outcomes measured on the original.

Inputs: `command` (string: "sync-collector-leg", "sync-yahoo-csv-leg", "load", "adjust", "import-csv", "export", "differential-a", "differential-b", "status"); `store_state` (string: "absent", "filled")  
Outputs: `outcome` ∈ "proceed", "refuse-wrapped", "refuse-traceback", "alert"; `message_or_action`

| rule | command | store_state | → | outcome | message_or_action | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| r1 | `"sync-collector-leg"` | `"absent"` | | proceed | first fill: fetch from the universe start (or open) and write every served row; no revisions | JDL-093, store.md s6 reconcile (empty series) |
| r2 | `"sync-collector-leg"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | tail refresh: fetch from the oldest of the newest tail sessions and reconcile | JDL-093, JDL-065 |
| r3 | `"sync-yahoo-csv-leg"` | `-` | | proceed | overwrite the series with the whole file | JDL-099, JDL-070 |
| r4 | `"load"` | `"absent"` | | proceed | first fill from --from (or open); append; re-adjust when raw and bars ingested | cli.md load step 4-5, JDL-141 |
| r5 | `"load"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | incremental from the day after the latest stored session; append; re-adjust when raw | cli.md load step 4-5, JDL-141 |
| r6 | `"adjust"` | `"absent"` | | refuse-traceback | StoreError: nothing stored for {exchange}/{symbol} | refusals.md X-02, JDL-069 |
| r7 | `"adjust"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | re-derive main OHLCV from *_raw with the stored splits (split_adjusted series refuse: X-03, a different input) | JDL-069; X-03 is on price_basis, not store state |
| r8 | `"import-csv"` | `-` | | proceed | overwrite the series with the CSV rows | JDL-070 |
| r9 | `"export"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | write the seam frame to F and print the validation report | cli.md export, JDL-138 |
| r10 | `"status"` | `"absent"` | | alert | never filled - no stored rows (jef-data sync first) | JDL-114 |
| r11 | `"status"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | run the source checks in JDL-110 order | JDL-110 |
| r12 | `"export"` | `"absent"` | | refuse-traceback | AttributeError: Can only use .dt accessor with datetimelike values. Did you mean: 'at'? | refusals.md X-09 (closing round), JDL-159 |
| r13 | `"differential-a"` | `"absent"` | | refuse-traceback | AttributeError: Can only use .dt accessor with datetimelike values. Did you mean: 'at'? | wave 2: measured on the original 2026-10-23 (A series absent, --b-csv given): exit 1, stdout empty |
| r14 | `"differential-b"` | `"absent"` | | refuse-traceback | AttributeError: Can only use .dt accessor with datetimelike values. Did you mean: 'at'? | wave 2: measured on the original 2026-10-23 (A stored, --b-symbol names an absent series): exit 1, stdout empty |
| r15 | `"differential-a"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | A = seam frame of a-exchange/S | cli.md differential, JDL-140, JDL-082 |
| r16 | `"differential-b"` | `"filled"` | | proceed | B = seam frame of b-exchange/S2 (or the CSV when --b-csv) | cli.md differential, JDL-140, JDL-082 |

## staleness_check (`status_verdicts.dmn`)
--staleness is encoded at its default (2); the threshold is an input of the program, a constant of this table.

Inputs: `series_has_rows` (boolean); `expected_sessions_missed` (integer: >= 0)  
Outputs: `finding` ∈ "ALERT_never_filled", "ALERT_stale", "none"; `ends_report`

| rule | series_has_rows | expected_sessions_missed | → | finding | ends_report | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| r1 | `false` | `-` | | ALERT_never_filled | true | JDL-114 |
| r2 | `true` | `< 2` | | none | false | JDL-116 below --staleness (default 2 encoded) |
| r3 | `true` | `>= 2` | | ALERT_stale | false | JDL-116: missed_sessions reported regardless |
